snippet.title: FNF: SPOOKY MIX 💀🎃 | OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Gamebanana: https://gamebanana.com/mods/551727
Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/spooky-mix/934455

Unlock the spookiest kids around town, Skid and Pump, as a new playable character! Play through 18 spoOoOoOoOky remixes of some of your favorite base game songs! Some Weeks have been given a spooky fresh coat of paint in the spirit of Halloween (any character/background that currently does not have a reskin will be getting one in the future).
